items.body: I turn complex problems into clear priorities, connecting user needs, business goals, and what’s worth building.
I combine user research, product data, and experimentation to make informed design decisions and measure what improves the experience.
I shape intuitive experiences, precise interfaces, and scalable design systems, bringing clarity and consistency to every detail.
I drive design from the first question to implementation, working with product and engineering to make trade-offs and deliver.
I combine AI tools, design, and code to explore more possibilities, test ideas earlier, and build working experiences faster.
